messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "That sounds promising. Can we see how reserves and payments sync with our existing accounting tools?",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "date": "2026-10-18T10:32:00Z",
   "quote": "That sounds promising. Can we see how reserves and payments sync with our existing accounting tools?",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-31T09:12:00+00:00",
   "quote": "That’d be great — I also need to sync up on the tasks for policyholders and make sure the integrations are pulling correctly.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-15T11:14:00Z",
   "quote": "Will do — have a great day.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-01T08:33:00+00:00",
   "quote": "That’d be great — we need those reserves figures locked in before we process any further payments to suppliers this week.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-28T16:59:00Z",
   "quote": "Sounds good. Thanks again, Alwen.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-06T16:28:00Z",
   "quote": "Good to hear. For now, can we at least manually merge them without losing any documents or supplier notes?",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-26T15:58:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Thanks, Bryn — really appreciate the quick help. Looking forward to the update too.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-18T12:21:00Z",
   "quote": "You too — and thanks for the help with the Welsh letter formats.",
   "route": "sales"
  }
 ],
 "title": "That sounds promising. Can we see how reserves and payments sync with"
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The title and problem statement are a sales inquiry asking to see how reserves and payments sync with existing accounting tools, not a report of a product defect. The quotes are largely pleasantries, thanks, and vague mentions of syncing integrations and manually merging records without losing documents, but none describe a concrete product problem or failure a squad could act on. There is no specific evidence of a product flaw, workaround caused by a defect, or actionable feature request.", "verdict": "fail"}
